limitations: Reference maximum power does not specify SPI pulse current or duration. Rows are hypothetical sensitivity, not measured performance.
50mA battery bound lacks approved pack datasheet. 10mA other load and 0.3V droop are analysis assumptions, not verified limits.
Nominal capacitance overstates effective ceramic capacitance under DC bias. ESR, tolerance, temperature, path drop and LDO stability excluded.
A capacitor alone does not enforce battery current limit; charging/inrush control and recovery energy must be designed.
LDO 200mA rating is a separate limitation; capacitor cannot support an indefinite overload.
decision: Do not add a token capacitor or approve generic microSD. Obtain exact card peak/busy/startup bounds plus qualified battery pulse limits, or evaluate a documented lower-current storage architecture. No circuit change adopted.
alternative_evidence: Swissbit official guide lists low-current SLC families at typical write 40/50mA; typical is not maximum and leaves no proven system margin. These are research candidates only, no exact SKU/price qualification.
